messages:
Jordan (CSM): Quick flag 1: Skyforge asked to swap signer and request a $9,500 midterm credit for unused seats. They said their procurement lead changed and procurement_new@skyforge.io will send a PO. @Ravi @Hanna could you confirm requirements? :eyes:

Leah (AM): Is this billing-only or are they asking to change the contract term?

Jordan (CSM): Billing-only per their note. Renewal date still 2026-09-01. They want credit applied to INV-2026-0780 (Mar invoice).

Ravi (Finance): Need: 1) PO referencing INV-2026-0780 or subscription id, 2) delegation from an on-file approver (email or signed letter). After docs, expect ~48h to create credit memo. Please ask them to include "apply to balance" in PO notes.

Hanna (Legal): Delegation must come from someone already on the signer roster. Email delegation is fine if we can validate the sender. No verbal approvals. If partner/reseller is issuing PO, we need explicit authority statement.

Jordan (CSM): Sending templates now (PO + delegation). Will paste reply here.

doc-bot: Saved thread (tag: midterm-credit-signer-swap).

Ravi (Finance): If they want expedited processing, include "urgent-credit" in subject and we can attempt same-day if docs arrive before 4pm PT.

Jordan (CSM): Action items:
- Jordan: collect docs and paste reply here (ETA today EOD)
- Leah: update renewal notes if credit applied
- Ravi: prepare CM once docs received
- Hanna: standby for delegation verification

Jordan (CSM): Marked renewal risk: low (operational). Will update on customer reply. :white_check_mark:
